# monotaur_monitor_status_rule (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur monitor status rule. Monitor status rules define conditions that set the status of a monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_monitor" "api_health" {
  name = "API Health Check"
  type = "Heartbeat"
}

resource "monotaur_monitor_status_rule" "degraded" {
  monitor_id     = monotaur_monitor.api_health.id
  predicate      = "latency > 500"
  status         = "Degraded"
  status_message = "Response time exceeds 500 ms"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this status rule belongs to.
- `predicate` (String) The predicate expression that determines when the rule applies.

### Optional

- `status` (String) The monitor status to apply when the predicate matches.
- `status_message` (String) A message to accompany the status when the predicate matches.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the monitor status rule was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the monitor status rule (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the monitor status rule was last updated (assigned by the API).
